title: CAP-007 / CAP-005 existing synthetic evidence versus replacement acceptance gates

capabilities.requirement: Real PostgreSQL ACID transfer with paired postings and outbox
capabilities.nextGate: Confirm actual business rules, observer-approved SQL oracle and multi-process cutover

capabilities.requirement: Stable operation ID replay and ID conflict
capabilities.nextGate: Specify idempotency policy including actor, policy version, rejected commands and expiration

capabilities.requirement: Process loss before SQL COMMIT and lost acknowledgment after COMMIT
capabilities.nextGate: Reproduce distinct SIGKILL/ack failures with independent state observations on release candidate

capabilities.requirement: Independent SQL accounting conservation and failure evidence
capabilities.nextGate: Qualify independent TODM G3/G5 baseline and archive original negative control

capabilities.requirement: Approved real customer transaction mandates, limits and policy exceptions
capabilities.nextGate: Acquire business-owner policy evidence and formal approval; no fake authorization flag

capabilities.requirement: Legacy/API compatibility, strangler routing and source of truth
capabilities.nextGate: Define capability routing, only-one-writer authority, read-only shadow and reconciliation

capabilities.requirement: Cutover, safe rollback and in-flight unknown command reconciliation
capabilities.nextGate: Demonstrate synthetic migration cutover with independent debit/outbox invariants

capabilities.requirement: Authoritative booked-balance read with externally exposed contract
capabilities.nextGate: Add .NET 10 persisted balance query bound to authoritative SQL and an approved account contract
Persist version and consumer watermark; instrument lag and reject stale requests against actual SQL

capabilities.requirement: Available balance with holds, reservations, effective dates and limits
capabilities.nextGate: Obtain business-owner definitions; booked balance is not available funds

capabilities.requirement: TODM independently approved baseline, G2 signature and human G6 authorization
capabilities.nextGate: Independent business mandate + exact source/runtime hashes; keep G6 BLOCK until granted

capabilities.requirement: Mainframe-equivalent throughput, operational SLA and disaster recovery
capabilities.nextGate: Measure representative load/latency and establish actual operator-approved targets; no MIPS=vCPU shortcut

assumptions: Existing E1a/E1b results prove only bounded synthetic, controlled database behavior under their documented workloads.
A newly written .NET 10 component does not make an existing-bank system a greenfield migration.
Golden Master characterization records incumbent behavior, not independently approved truth.
TODM G5 candidate matching a synthetic oracle never implies G6 business acceptance.
No parser is required; optional code archaeology must be justified by a named unknown.
